summary: Backend pytest for Courses & Certification (17/17 pass) + frontend smoke on /admin/courses and public /certificate/{token}. Backend covers list shape (courses/can_manage/can_assign/my/departments), create validation (empty title 400, invalid dept 400), GET detail with stats + challenges + can_manage, PUT pass_pct (80->85->80), manager RBAC (POST 403, PUT 403, list can_manage=false but can_assign=true, GET /people returns users but targets=[]), rep RBAC (GET /people 403), enroll idempotency (second assign returns same enrollment, notified=0), enrollment_detail, rep sees my[] in list_courses, rep GET /courses/{id} has my_enrollment populated, direct service call cs.record_result with score_pct=90 on each challenge -> status flips to certified, certificate_token set, certificate_url contains /certificate/, GET /api/public/certificate/{token} (no auth) returns name/course_title/badge_label/challenges[*].best_pct==90, invalid token -> 404, notifications collection has 'course_certified' entries for BOTH rep user_id AND assigner (forest), DELETE enrollment -> 200 + GET 404, DELETE course -> 200 + GET 404. Frontend smoke: login as forest, navigate via history.pushState to /admin/courses -> courses-header + courses-add visible, header text 'Courses & Certification / 1 course'; tapping courses-add opens course-sheet with course-title, description textarea, department chips (Sales/Service/Parts/Rental/Mixed with Sales pre-selected), pass mark 80, badge label placeholder, course-save button 'Create course' all rendered. Public certificate error page (no auth, incognito context) with invalid 32-char token renders certificate-error with exact copy 'This certificate link is not valid.'
critical_code_review_comments: services/courses.certify() correctly guards duplicate certifications via idempotent $pull-then-$push of the user certification entry and only writes assigner notification when assigned_by != user_id (self-enroll edge case handled).
record_result correctly ignores sessions whose script_id is not in the current course.challenge_ids (protects against stray sessions after course edit).
routers/courses._recheck() re-certifies enrollments after a course edit that changed pass_pct or challenge_ids - good, keeps prior passers valid without needing to re-run.
public/certificate route requires token length >=16, prevents trivial 4xx probing; invalid token deterministically 404.
assign() enforces per-user store scope for managers (line 206-207) and blocks target enrollment for non-owner roles (line 213-214).
unenroll() also cancels scheduled mystery_shop roleplay_sessions for that enrollment - good cleanup coupling.
delete_course (retire) cancels any scheduled shop calls for the course - good.

success_rate.frontend: smoke: 100% of exercised elements (courses-header, courses-add, course-sheet + fields, certificate-error)
